recipes.title: Garlic Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice and spread it on a plate to cool for a few minutes.
Melt butter in a hot pan, add minced garlic, and fry for 30 seconds.
Push the garlic aside, scramble the egg, then toss in the rice.
Splash in soy sauce, keep tossing for 2 minutes, and finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Tomato & Cheese Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and chopped chili.
Melt butter in a small pan over medium heat and add diced tomato for 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and let the base set without stirring.
Scatter cheese, fold the omelette, and slide it onto a plate.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Noodles
steps: Boil the noodles until just tender, keeping a cup of the cooking water.
Stir peanut butter, soy sauce, minced garlic, and chili with a little hot water into a smooth sauce.
Toss the drained noodles through the sauce, loosening with cooking water.
Serve immediately, topping with extra chili if you like heat.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces and season with a little soy sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot pan until golden, then set aside.
Scramble the egg in the same pan, add cold rice, and fry for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add garlic and spring onion, splash soy sauce, and toss to finish.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt.
Melt butter in a skillet, add garlic and chili, and fry until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and spoon the pan butter over the top.

recipes.title: Weeknight Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the ground beef in a hot pan, breaking it up with a spoon.
Add onion, chili, and a pinch of salt; cook until softened.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side.
Fill with beef, top with tomato and cheese, and eat straight away.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Rinse the canned beans and warm them in a pan with a splash of water.
Mash roughly, add diced onion, and season well.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with the beans, add tomato, cheese, and a hit of hot sauce.

recipes.title: Coconut Vegetable Curry
steps: Fry onion and garlic in a little oil until soft.
Add curry paste and stir for 30 seconds until it smells toasted.
Add carrot and bell pepper with a few spoons of coconut milk; simmer 10 minutes.
Add mushroom and the rest of the coconut milk; simmer 5 more minutes.
Taste, adjust salt, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Curry
steps: Start the rice so it finishes with the curry.
Fry onion and garlic until soft, then add curry paste for 30 seconds.
Add bite-size chicken pieces and stir to coat.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer 12–15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Taste and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Tomato Garlic Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water until al dente.
Meanwhile, gently fry onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add chopped tomato and simmer into a quick sauce, seasoning with salt.
Drain the pasta, toss through the sauce, and finish with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta until al dente, reserving a mug of cooking water.
Fry mushrooms in butter until browned, then add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add spinach to wilt, then the pasta and a splash of cooking water.
Stir in cheese off the heat until glossy and serve.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Toastie
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Layer cheese between the slices, buttered side out.
Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing gently, 3 minutes a side.
Cut in half while the cheese is still stretchy.

recipes.title: Bacon & Spinach Toastie
steps: Crisp the bacon in a dry pan, then drain on paper.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan for 30 seconds.
Build the toastie: bread, cheese, bacon, spinach, cheese, bread.
Butter the outside and grill 3 minutes a side until golden.

recipes.title: Eggs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Soften onion, garlic, and bell pepper in olive oil.
Add chopped tomato and simmer 8 minutes into a thick sauce.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook until the whites set.
Serve in the pan with bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Crispy Potato Hash
steps: Dice the potato small so it cooks quickly; par-boil 5 minutes and drain.
Fry in olive oil undisturbed until golden on one side, then toss.
Add onion and bell pepper; cook until everything is tender.
Crack in an egg, cover, and cook until just set.

recipes.title: Tofu Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Press the tofu, cube it, and fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Remove the tofu; stir-fry broccoli and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add garlic, return the tofu, and splash in soy sauce.
Toss once more and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Slice the chicken thinly and sear in a hot pan until golden.
Add carrot and broccoli; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add bell pepper and garlic; cook 1 more minute.
Return any juices, add soy sauce, and serve straight over rice.

recipes.title: Lemon Butter Salmon
steps: Start the rice according to the packet.
Season the salmon and sear skin-side down in a hot pan for 4 minutes.
Flip, add butter and lemon slices, and baste for 2 minutes.
Serve the salmon on wilted spinach with rice and the pan butter.

recipes.title: Honey Yogurt Oat Bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with oats.
Drizzle with honey and eat immediately.

recipes.title: Honey Butter Toast
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Spread generously with butter while hot.
Drizzle honey over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Rinse and roughly mash the beans with diced onion and hot sauce.
Spread onto half a tortilla and top with cheese.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2 minutes a side until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Start the rice.
Sear bite-size chicken pieces until golden; set aside.
Cook garlic briefly, then add honey and soy sauce to make a glaze.
Return the chicken, toss until sticky, and serve on rice.

recipes.title: Bacon Fried Rice
steps: Fry chopped bacon until crisp and leave the fat in the pan.
Push bacon aside, scramble the egg, then add cold rice.
Fry everything together for 3 minutes with a splash of soy sauce.
Finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Chili Garlic Noodles
steps: Boil the noodles and drain, reserving a little water.
Sizzle minced garlic and chili in olive oil until fragrant.
Add soy sauce and a spoon of noodle water; stir.
Toss the noodles through and serve right away.

recipes.title: Veggie Yogurt Wrap
steps: Stir yogurt with a pinch of salt to make a quick sauce.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan.
Spread with yogurt and fill with spinach, tomato, onion, and cheese.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

recipes.title: Fluffy French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs with a splash of water.
Soak thick slices of bread for 20 seconds a side.
Fry in butter over medium heat until golden, 2 minutes a side.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Beef Broccoli Rice Bowl
steps: Start the rice.
Brown the ground beef, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Add garlic and broccoli with a splash of water; cover and steam 4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and pile everything onto the rice.
